name: Paharpur (Somapura Mahavihara)
summary: A UNESCO World Heritage site: the ruins of a great 8th-century Buddhist monastery, the largest known south of the Himalayas.
season_note: Winter is best for walking on the ruins.
avoid_note: Summer is hot and shade is limited.

reach.how: AC coach from Dhaka (Gabtoli) to Bogura or Joypurhat, then local bus
Intercity train to Bogura or Joypurhat, then road

local.note: From the main road to the site.

attractions.name: Somapura Mahavihara ruins
attractions.what: A giant square monastery with a central temple and 177 cells.
attractions.tip: Go early or late in the day to avoid heat.

attractions.name: Paharpur Site Museum
attractions.what: Terracotta plaques and finds from the dig.

attractions.name: Kantajew Temple (Dinajpur)
attractions.what: An ornamented terracotta Hindu temple a short drive away.

rules: Do not climb on the ruins.
